dynamic_rules.new_behavior: office_scope on the 11 reports of this category that have OFFICE/GROUP (all except Patient's Notes, which has no office parameter: scope.office_mode = none, patient visibility via assert_patient_visible): the mode radio decides the value key. Mode office -> the picker lists offices (lookup:offices) and writes office_ids (list, token working_office (default), my_offices or all). dynamic_rules.legacy_effect: The CREATED DATE RANGE section is replaced by a SEND STATEMENT STATUS dropdown (Yes / No); EXCLUDE RESPONSIBLE PARTY TYPE and the inactive-accounts checkbox (Include Inactive Accounts (All patients inactive in account)) stay.
dynamic_rules.new_behavior: report_by == send_statement_status: send_statement_status becomes visible and required (required_when report_by == send_statement_status); date_range is hidden (visible_when report_by != send_statement_status, 04 shared rule) and no created-date predicate is applied; exclude_resp_party_type_codes and include_inactive_accounts stay visible. In every other mode send_statement_status is hidden and adds no predicate. report_by == balance_aged_over_x_days additionally shows aged_balance (aged_balance_from / _to, default 1.00 / 999999.99) and aging_days (04 shared vendor-doc parameters; no control of our capture, specified in the report section).
